svg.title: Watch LexGuard work: a contract through the pipeline
svg.desc: Illustrative run of LexGuard's pipeline on a four-clause contract. Stages: classifier, risk analyst plus adversarial judge, safety net with 38 trap patterns, citation verifier, fairer rewrite. The classifier tags clauses as non_compete, compensation, termination and payment. The risk analyst rates the non-compete HIGH and a training-bond clause LOW; the safety net overrules both to CRITICAL (post-employment non-compete, punitive training bond). The citation verifier marks Indian Contract Act s.27 and s.74 strong and s.412 hallucinated, not in corpus. The training bond gets a fairer rewrite: costs repayable pro rata, only within 12 months, capped at actual cost. Benchmark: 28 of 30 clause types, 21 of 30 risk tiers, 0 risky clauses under-rated.
svg.text: LexGuard: a contract through the pipeline

text.tspan: Employee shall not join any competitor anywhere
in India for 2 years after leaving.
If Employee resigns within 24 months, Employee
Training costs repayable pro rata, only for resignation within 12 months,
Either party may terminate with 30 days'
Invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt.
